generative_adversarial_network.summary: One generator-discriminator pair per class (down / up, or price bin) learns what that class's feature rows look like; a classifier trained on the generated rows says which class a new bar most resembles.
generative_adversarial_network.implementationNote: Bridge: posterior via a classifier trained only on generated rows, plus the train class share (Bayes under the generator). Differs from the spec: one unconditional GAN per class generates a bar's causal feature row; class-conditional density of the current feature row plus bayes' rule; not a model of future paths. Expect: near the base rate; the logged real-vs-fake accuracy says how realistic the rows are.

latent_dimension.label: Latent dimension
latent_dimension.description: Size of the noise vector z the generator turns into a feature row.

hidden_size.label: Hidden size
hidden_size.description: Units in every hidden layer of the generator, the discriminator and the posterior classifier.

layer_count.label: Layer count
layer_count.description: Hidden layers of the generator and of the discriminator.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: Adam step size of the generator and the discriminator.

epochs.label: Generator epochs
epochs.description: Passes of the adversarial game over the training rows before the synthetic rows are drawn.

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.description: Training rows per optimisation step; batches are shuffled rows of the training span.

samples_per_class.label: Samples per class
samples_per_class.description: Synthetic rows drawn from the generator for EACH class once it is trained; the posterior classifier is trained on these rows only (train on synthetic, test on real).

classifier_epochs.label: Classifier epochs
classifier_epochs.description: Passes of the posterior classifier over the synthetic rows, at most; it stops early when the real validation rows stop improving.

patience.label: Early stopping patience
patience.description: Posterior-classifier epochs without a better validation loss before it stops and the best one is restored.

bin_count.label: Price bins
bin_count.description: Price model only: the price target is cut into this many quantile bins of the training rows; each bin is one class of the generator and the forecast is the expected bin mean.

conditional_gan.summary: One generator and one discriminator both told the class (down / up, or price bin), so a single network learns every class's feature rows; a classifier trained on its generated rows scores new bars.
conditional_gan.implementationNote: Bridge: posterior via a classifier trained only on generated rows, plus the train class share (Bayes under the generator). Differs from the spec: conditioned on the outcome class (one-hot), generating a causal feature row; class-conditional density of the current feature row plus bayes' rule; not a model of future paths. Expect: near the base rate; the logged real-vs-fake accuracy says how realistic the rows are.

wasserstein_gan.summary: A class-conditional generator trained against a critic that estimates the Wasserstein (earth mover's) distance to the real rows, kept 1-Lipschitz by a gradient penalty; its generated rows train the classifier.
wasserstein_gan.implementationNote: Bridge: posterior via a classifier trained only on generated rows, plus the train class share (Bayes under the generator). Differs from the spec: WGAN-GP (gradient penalty, not clipping), conditioned on the outcome class, generating a feature row; the critic is not a density. Expect: near the base rate; the logged real-vs-fake accuracy says how realistic the rows are.

big_generative_adversarial.summary: BigGAN's machinery at the scale of one bar's features: class-conditional batch norm, skip-z, spectral norm, a projection discriminator with hinge loss and a moving-average generator; its generated rows train the classifier.
big_generative_adversarial.implementationNote: Bridge: posterior via a classifier trained only on generated rows, plus the train class share (Bayes under the generator). Differs from the spec: a feature row, not an image; conditional batch norm, skip-z, spectral norm, projection hinge loss, orthogonal penalty, EMA and truncation are kept. Expect: near the base rate; the logged real-vs-fake accuracy says how realistic the rows are.

style_gan.summary: A mapping network turns noise and the class into a style w that modulates every layer of a synthesis network started from a learned constant, with noise injection and style mixing; its generated rows train the classifier.
style_gan.implementationNote: Bridge: posterior via a classifier trained only on generated rows, plus the train class share (Bayes under the generator). Differs from the spec: a feature row, no resolutions; mapping network, demodulated layers, noise, style mixing, truncation, minibatch deviation and R1 are kept. Expect: near the base rate; the logged real-vs-fake accuracy says how realistic the rows are.

self_supervised_gan.summary: A class-conditional hinge GAN whose discriminator also solves a contrastive task (recognising two noisy views of the same row), which keeps its features informative; its generated rows train the classifier.
self_supervised_gan.implementationNote: Bridge: posterior via a classifier trained only on generated rows, plus the train class share (Bayes under the generator). Differs from the spec: the discriminator's task is InfoNCE on two augmented views, not rotation; the route is the generated rows (fixed), not a discriminator probe. Expect: near the base rate; the logged real-vs-fake accuracy says how realistic the rows are.

adversarial_autoencoder.summary: A semi-supervised adversarial autoencoder: the encoder splits a bar's features into a style code and a class, discriminators push both toward their priors, and the class head q(class | features) is the prediction.
adversarial_autoencoder.implementationNote: Bridge: P(up) is the model's own class head q(up | features) (Makhzani et al.'s semi-supervised AAE); train-span bars without a known outcome are the unlabelled pool. Differs from the spec: reconstructs a causal feature row, not an image, and does not model future paths. Expect: the supervised head carries most of the signal; compare with adversarial_weight 0.

cycle_consistent_gan.summary: Two translators learn to turn down-bars into up-bars and back without paired examples; a bar that the up-translator barely moves and the discriminators call up-like is scored up.
cycle_consistent_gan.implementationNote: Bridge: a translation-displacement score and the discriminator gap, calibrated on validation (a 3-parameter logistic). Differs from the spec: the two domains are the train span's down and up bars (unpaired by construction), translated as feature rows; the price model regresses the target on the displacements. Expect: a heuristic separation score near the base rate.

identity_weight.description: Weight of |G(b) - b| + |F(a) - a|: a row already in the target domain should be left alone.

replay_buffer_size.description: Generated rows kept for the discriminators (0 = no history).
